answer: THE AVERAGE v IN (OperationalMetric has OperationalMetricMtbfh mtbf AND ALSO has OperationalMetricMttrh mttr AND ALSO has OperationalMetricMaintcost mc AND ALSO has PlantRecordSnapts ts AND ALSO has Plant has PlantGoliveon g AND ALSO (days_between(ts, g) * 24) AS th AND ALSO (mc / (th / mtbf)) AS v WHERE mtbf > 0 AND th > 0 AND mttr / (mtbf + mttr) > 0.05)
THE SUM OF v IN (Plant has modhook PanelModel has PanelModelDegyrrate d AND ALSO (d * 400000 * 50 * 15) AS v WHERE d * 20 > 14)

LIST pk, a FROM ElectricalPerformance has ElectricalPerformanceIvCurveVmpInitialV vi AND ALSO has ElectricalPerformanceIvCurveVmpNowV vn AND ALSO has Plant has modhook PanelModel has PanelModelPnlkind k WHERE vi > 0 AND ALSO lower(k) AS pk AND ALSO ((vi - vn) / vi) AS v AND ALSO THE AVERAGE v GROUPED BY pk AS a ORDERED WITH a DESCENDING
LIST l, wc FROM Plant has PlantSitelabel l AND ALSO has PlantWarrclaims wc AND ALSO has PlantWarrstate ws WHERE wc > 2 AND lower(ws) = 'claimed' ORDERED WITH wc DESCENDING

round(THE AVERAGE m IN (OperationalMetric has OperationalMetricMttrh m AND ALSO has ElectricalPerformanceEfficiencyCumulativeDegPct cd AND ALSO has PlantRecordSnapts ts AND ALSO has Plant has PlantGoliveon g AND ALSO (days_between(ts, g) / 365.25) AS age WHERE age <> 0 AND cd / age > 0.5), 2)

LIST round(mttr / (mtbf + mttr), 4) FROM OperationalMetric has Plant has PlantSitelabel l AND ALSO has OperationalMetricMttrh mttr AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has OperationalMetricMtbfh mtbf WHERE lower(l) = 'solar plant west davidport'

round(THE AVERAGE v IN (OperationalMetric has Plant has modhook PanelModel has PanelModelPnlkind pk AND ALSO has OperationalMetricMaintcost mc AND ALSO has OperationalMetricMtbfh mtbf WHERE lower(pk) = 'hjt' AND mtbf > 0 AND ALSO (mc / (17520 / mtbf)) AS v), 0)

round(THE AVERAGE d IN (MechanicalCondition has MechanicalConditionModuleSurfaceBusbarCorrosion bc AND ALSO has ElectricalPerformanceIvCurveFillFactorInitial ffi AND ALSO has ElectricalPerformanceIvCurveFillFactorNow ffn AND ALSO (ffi - ffn) AS d WHERE lower(bc) = 'severe'), 3)
